# private-index

## Plugin reference

- Description: Refresh a checkout's index on a private copy, then publish it back: copy the index WITH its mtime (racy git), let git write the copy (privateIndexWrites), and swap it into place by compare-and-swap under git's own index.lock taken wx — skipped while a git writer holds the lock or once the real index was written since the copy. One protocol, in a sync form (the tree hash, on the CLI's thread) and an async one (a backend's checkout primer).
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/host-fs/user-path.AppPath`
    - `infra/host-fs/user-path.appPathParent`
    - `infra/host-fs/user-path.joinAppPath`
    - `packages/owned-fd.openOwnedFdSync`
    - `packages/timed-fs.stat`
    - `packages/timed-fs.statSync`
  - Exports (types):
    - `IndexPublish`
    - `SeenIndex`
  - Exports (values):
    - `copyIndex`
    - `publishRefreshedIndex`
    - `publishRefreshedIndexSync`
    - `writeIndexCopySync`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `framework/tooling/checks`
    - `infra/git/index-refresh`
- Exemptions:
  - Exempts itself from: `boundaries/no-platform-api` — `core/internal/private-index.ts` (debt)
